actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Punish Resident2 for repeat low contributions (severity 10, cost 3) as priority rule, and broadcast the norm message for round 16.

message.reasoning: We need decide action for round 16 (current). Wallet 3.26, below 30% of initial (30). Conserve rule says contribute 30% of wallet ≈0.978. But also punish rule higher priority if repeat free-rider exists. Check Resident2 contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds (14 and 15). Contributions: round14 Resident2 gave 1.0 (endowment 100, so 1% <10%). round15 Resident2 gave 0.0 (0%). Yes repeat. So punish with severity 10 cost 3. Wallet 3.26 can afford cost 3 (punishment_cost 0.3 *10 =3). After paying cost, wallet reduces to 0.26. Must choose at most one physical action. Punish is priority higher than conserve, so we punish and no contribution. Also broadcast round? round number 16, broadcast needed every 5 rounds starting at 1: rounds 1,6,11,16... Yes round 16 is broadcast round. Constitution says broadcast norm each 5 rounds. Should we also broadcast? Only one communication allowed, we can broadcast. So actions: punish Resident2 severity 10, and broadcast norm message. Provide both.
